title: Introduction and overview — Richelieu-class Battleship
description: Introduction and overview of the Richelieu-class Battleship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. France's Richelieu class — two completed — mounted all eight 15-inch guns forward in two quadruple turrets, a radical layout for engaging while chasing. Richelieu served with the Free French and British Eastern Fleet; Jean Bart was completed after the war. They were France's last battleships. Baseline facts: French battleship; 2 completed; all guns forward in quadruple turrets..
